write_up: Your resume tells a coherent story: you moved from object storage at Nimbus Cloud to fraud, reconciliation and platform leadership at Brightline Payments. A recruiter can see the systems you've built and led. The main question is how much the biggest changes moved for the business and the teams using them.

The idempotency line is the model: it names your action and the duplicate-charge problem it eliminated. Your progression at Brightline and the technical detail in the fraud pipeline also make the staff title credible.

Let's start with the ledger redesign and the platform team. Add the scale of your leadership and what changed after the redesign, if you can substantiate it. Then give the reconciliation improvements a measure so those results are as concrete as the fraud pipeline.
